placeholders.{line}: 1-based line number when a walkthrough step highlights a single line (startLine === endLine) in PracticalExample.tsx.
placeholders.{startLine}: 1-based starting line number when a walkthrough step highlights a range (startLine !== endLine) in PracticalExample.tsx.
placeholders.{endLine}: 1-based ending line number when a walkthrough step highlights a range in PracticalExample.tsx.
placeholders.{lines}: Pre-formatted localized line label returned by lineLabel(startLine, endLine) (e.g., 'Line 4' or 'Lines 3-6' with numeric en dash).
placeholders.{score}: Two-decimal cosine similarity score formatted via item.semanticScore.toFixed(2) (e.g., '0.84') in SemanticSearch.tsx.
placeholders.{term}: Saved annotation term or phrase on indexed explanation chunks in SemanticSearch.tsx / server/knowledge.ts.
placeholders.{name}: Attached source document filename on indexed document chunks in SemanticSearch.tsx / server/knowledge.ts.
placeholders.{page}: 1-based PDF page number clamped to [1, pages] in page-references.tsx.

budgets.layoutNote: At 320px / 360px viewports (288px / 328px outer card width; .practical-example uses 16px padding below 620px = 256px / 296px inner width; .semantic-search uses 15px padding below 620px = 258px / 298px inner width), flex-wrap rules on .practical-code-caption, .practical-result-heading, .semantic-heading, and .semantic-citation prevent horizontal overflow. Mode badges ('Meaning + keywords' 18 chars, 'Keyword search' 14 chars) and citation items ('Note passage' 12 chars + 'Similarity 0.84' 15 chars = ~174px <= 234px result inner width at 320px) fit cleanly without clipping.

rationale: Preserves all shipped Taiwanese zh-TW strings byte-for-byte across PracticalExample.tsx (22 keys), SemanticSearch.tsx + server/knowledge.ts search outputs (15 keys), and page-references.tsx (1 key) so existing zh-TW UI and tests stay 100% non-regressing.

Aligns English nouns with BELL-Explain's shipped glossary in ui-strings.json, explain-pdf-viewer.json, and annotation-explanation-card.json: Library for the saved-notes collection, note for lesson documents, Explanation for saved term annotations, Expected output for program output, and original PDF for source PDFs.

Keeps predict-first prompts warm, encouraging, and honest ('not saved', 'Traced from the code / Not run live' with middle dot in copy) so learners know upfront their scratch prediction stays private in memory and the output is traced rather than executed.

Translates vector/embedding concepts into plain, beginner-friendly English ('Meaning + keywords', 'Keyword search', 'Turn on the multilingual search model in Settings...') while keeping the hover tooltip on Similarity {score} clear that cosine similarity ranks results rather than measuring accuracy.
assumptions: PracticalExample.tsx lineLabel(startLine, endLine) uses practicalExample.lineSingle ({line}) when startLine === endLine and practicalExample.lineRange ({startLine}, {endLine}, joined by numeric en dash U+2013) otherwise, then passes the formatted string as {lines} into currentFocus and stepButtonAria.

SemanticSearch.tsx lessonTitle(title) splits indexed note chunk titles on the server's Chinese explanation and document suffixes produced at index time by server/knowledge.ts; annotationTitleSuffix and documentTitleSuffix let lessonTitle() render localized English suffixes under ?lang=en without reindexing SQLite.

server/knowledge.ts sets KnowledgeSearch.warning to semanticFallbackWarning when embedding query execution fails at search time; pairing it here lets SemanticSearch.tsx localize result.warning under ?lang=en while leaving server responses untouched.
